criteria.criterion: All retained context cases preserve mandatory acceptance material and expose unknown/opaque frontiers.
criteria.explanation: Twenty-five retained cases from the controlled fixture and IsolatedPatchWorktree suite all kept target/surrounding/test source CIDs and obligation material in both raw and semantic packs, and ContextCompiler retained goal/authority/scope/acceptance. Opaque, heuristic, native, dynamic, and raw-source frontiers were recorded on every retained row; the unsupported CST/alias surface was explicitly not retained as an implemented claim.

criteria.criterion: Cold/incremental roots and selected/full validation agree within the declared profile; mismatches receive failures and cause fixes or explicit limitations.
criteria.explanation: For every producer case, cold and verified-incremental state_cid and semantic-state root_cid agreed. Pytest selected-versus-full execution on the declared subset (unchanged, local_body, format, native, delete, fixture, lock) found no missed full-suite failures. Dynamic/monkey/config/lock cases used full_pytest/both fallback inside the allow_full_fallback policy rather than silently dropping coverage. No mismatch was relabeled as success.

criteria.criterion: Valid source-bound patches apply and stale/out-of-scope preimages reject.
criteria.explanation: IsolatedPatchWorktree applied the local_body unified diff against an exact pkg/core.py preimage, changing only the fenced worktree (pre_tree 72204e13c53a3df5a76c690a8b04fa77a4c3c374 to post_tree 38841d5c12301203d554b9f4908d95f08936dccb) while leaving the caller root unchanged. A stale visibility map and an empty visibility map were rejected as invisible_preimage. An out-of-scope policy.toml patch was rejected. Baseline capsules assessed against the mutated root were stale and required raw source.

criteria.criterion: Context reduction is measured with the same actual tokenizer for both modes, with fallback rates retained.
criteria.explanation: Raw and semantic ContextPacks for each producer case shared one CalibratedTokenEstimator object (context-compiler-calibrated_utf8@1). No provider tokenizer (tiktoken) is installed; fallback_rate=1.0 is retained. Measured semantic-versus-raw token fractions on this fixture were negative (min -0.7544, max -0.2786, n=19) because required never-compress sources stayed in both modes and capsules were additive evidence, not a claimed tokenizer saving.
